I will do this plot much like last season because money is tight and I cannot risk buying many inputs. My maize plot is small, and I own it, so I will carry manure from home and put a little chemical fertilizer where I can, but not too much because one bag costs plenty. I will keep my local seed that I trust, mix the crop as I usually do, and weed by hand with family work. I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains, and I will only call a few people for help when the work is heavy.
